title: TallPlan Adam's Apple Height Predictor
summary: Adapts the viral Adam's apple height correlation hook into an animated explainer leading to TallPlan's height growth app.
style: Minimalist 2D flat vector animation, clean outlines, smooth digital cartoon aesthetic, solid neutral studio background, mint green accent glows.
character: 20-year-old young man, short dark brown hair, black crewneck t-shirt, grey casual pants, white sneakers.
character_prompt: Minimalist 2D flat vector illustration, a 20-year-old young man standing in side profile, short dark hair, black t-shirt, grey pants, white sneakers, clean lines, solid neutral background, single character, no text.

keyframes.name: tall_measuring_pose
keyframes.prompt: Minimalist 2D vector art, tall young man smiling next to a vertical height ruler bar, standing straight with confident posture, solid light beige background.

keyframes.name: short_comparison_pose
keyframes.prompt: Minimalist 2D vector art, shorter young man in a blue hoodie looking frustrated next to a taller man resting a hand on his head, clean vector graphic.

shots.visual: Camera zooms in on the neck of a young man, highlighting an exaggerated prominent Adam's apple pulsing with a bright mint green glow ring. SFX: Whoosh cut, subtle resonant chime.
shots.vo: If your Adam's apple is visible early on, you could hit six feet tall naturally.

shots.visual: Fast whip pan to the man smiling upright beside a height measurement stadiometer, mint green line zipping up past the top marker. SFX: Quick swoosh, digital rising whistle.
shots.vo: Your growth plates often stay active longer, signaling a major late growth spurt.

shots.visual: Cut to a shorter young adult in a blue hoodie looking down dejectedly at a low height marker. SFX: Bass drop thud, low record slide.
shots.vo: But if your throat line is smooth, your potential height might stall early.

shots.visual: Whip pan to the shorter man jumping into an upward vertical stretch, glowing mint green directional arrows lifting up along his spine. SFX: Dynamic whoosh, bright sparkle chime.
shots.vo: You can still unlock hidden inches with targeted spinal decompression routines.

shots.visual: Lower-third framing of the character standing confidently tall with glowing mint posture lines; top half remains open for app UI overlay. SFX: Warm success shimmer.
shots.vo: Start your personalized growth routine today in TallPlan.

voice: Male, 20s, North American accent, dynamic and confident explainer tone, ~190 WPM, crisp close-mic podcast audio.
music: Punchy upbeat lo-fi hip hop beat, 115 BPM, bouncy synth bass, crisp snare, motivational vibe, instrumental only.

qa_checks.character: Consistent 2D vector art style with clean flat colors, dark hair, and casual streetwear.
qa_checks.pose: Upright posture measurement pose transitioning to athletic vertical stretch with mint green indicators.
